parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two university students who are on a low
income.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cake using the creaming method and make a dish using rough puff pastry.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different main ingredient
chicken, eggs, nuts, pulses, rice, soya, wholemeal flour.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two adult friends who are training to run a
marathon.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a cold savoury snack and a cold sweet snack that they can take to their next training
session. The snacks must be suitable for eating without cutlery.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes suitable for a packed meal for two office workers.
The dishes must be suitable to be eaten cold.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using a roux sauce and a dish using a steamer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes that are rich in vitamin A.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cake using the whisking method and make a batch of biscuits.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two elderly relatives.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a cold savoury dish for the elderly relatives to take home and make a batch of small
cakes or a tray bake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful hot savoury dishes, each to show the use of a different
part of the cooker (oven, hob and grill / broiler).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a sweet dish using yeast and make a batch of scones.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two teenage girls that is high in iron and
vitamin C.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a dish using a piece of labour-saving equipment and make a batch of scones.
